## Use the data directly

The lab's Goldmine contains populated, ordinary writable files at `02_prospects/kiribati-biomarkers.data/releases/v0.2.2/` relative to its root. Open these files with Python, R, or your usual tools; no DataLad commands are required. Ask the lab operator for the Goldmine root if needed. Work on a personal copy when making changes to a shared release.

## Retrieve the archived version with DataLad

Set `DEPOT_STORE` to the dataset's RIA store path supplied by the lab operator. Use these commands to retrieve the pinned release:

<pre><code>datalad clone &quot;ria+file://$&#123;DEPOT_STORE&#125;#~kiribati-biomarkers&quot; kiribati-biomarkers
cd kiribati-biomarkers
git checkout --detach 428bb3ae8faecd3f05ab6fab027b06ff34231834
datalad get releases/v0.2.2</code></pre>

Package metadata: releases/v0.2.2/datapackage.json.

Prospects can change between versions. Refined releases follow a stricter schedule.
